about: Art manifest for Closer Bible Moments. 'id' matches the id in constants/bibleMomentsData.json. All 78 moments have art. Download image_url and save it as suggested_file, then attach it to the moment with the same id.

format.aspect: Images are UNCROPPED 3:4 portrait. The team crops them to the final card shape. Do not apply any earlier 5:7 crop or label-zone assumption unless explicitly told.
format.models: 69 moments: nano_banana_pro at 2k, plain scene prompts (no label-zone or edge instructions). 9 moments (mary-annunciation, thief-cross, jesus-baptized, transfiguration, crucifixion, ascension, pentecost, psalm-22, pierced-mourned): nano_banana_pro at 4k with portrait composition instructions. The generation tool reports these jobs as nano_banana_2.

version: v4. Replaces the Seedream set. previous_seedream_image_url is kept for reference only; do not use it.
prompt_template: A 3D CGI render in the style of a modern animated feature film: clean smooth polished surfaces, stylized rounded geometry, physically based materials, soft subsurface scattering, ray-traced global illumination, crisp sharp rendering with shallow depth of field, vivid saturated color with strong warm-versus-cool contrast, glowing rim light. This is NOT a painting: no brush strokes, no painterly texture, no watercolor, no oil paint, no concept-art sketchiness, no 2D illustration. Color grade: {color_grade}. Scene: {scene_beat} All people are adults with normal adult proportions, appearing small in the frame only because they are far from the camera, seen from behind or in distant silhouette, no visible faces. No children. No text, no halos, no crosses, no religious symbols, no beams of light from the sky.
